ADRENALINE INJECTION PEN - six steps.

STEP 1 Amination (26-60 C): catechol + N-hydroxymethyl base solution + lipobond agent gives amination intermediate
STEP 2 Reduction (60-80 C): amination intermediate + reducing agent gives racemic adrenaline
STEP 3 Resolution (40-60 C acid catalyst): racemic adrenaline + resolving agent + acid gives levo-adrenaline salt + dextro waste. Remove the waste with the purifier waste slot.
STEP 4 Salt formation (26-60 C): levo salt + base gives free base; free base + acid gives adrenaline HCl. Evaporate water then press the dry liquid in the Chem Finisher to get the API
STEP 5 Solution: dissolve the API in an equal amount of water gives adrenaline solution (evaporate excess water)
STEP 6 Filling: press the dry adrenaline solution in the Chem Finisher gives the injection pen
